# ankra_ankracloud_zones (Data Source)

The Ankra Cloud zones a cluster can be deployed in, for `zone` on `ankra_ankracloud_cluster`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Without credential_id the organisation's built-in Ankra Cloud credential is used.
data "ankra_ankracloud_zones" "all" {}

output "ankracloud_zones" {
  value = data.ankra_ankracloud_zones.all.zones[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `credential_id` (String) Ankra Cloud credential to read the catalogue through. Unset uses the organisation's built-in Ankra Cloud credential.

### Read-Only

- `incomplete_reasons` (List of String) Why `pricing_complete` is false; empty when it is true.
- `pricing_complete` (Boolean) Whether the platform could read every zone's capabilities; when false, a zone may be missing from `zones`.
- `zones` (Attributes List) Deployable zones. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones))

<a id="nestedatt--zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `zones`

Read-Only:

- `country` (String) Country code.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `name` (String) Zone name, e.g. `se-sto1`.
- `region` (String) Region the zone is in.
